description.zh:
要接收消息的设备名称。

> - 与**ProductKey**结合使用，传入设备必须属于同一产品。
- 单次调用，最多传入100个设备名称，且设备名称不可重复。
description.en:
The device name of the device that accepts the message.  

> - This parameter must be used together with **ProductKey**. The specified device must belong to the same product.  
- In a single API call, you can specify up to 100 device names, and the device names must be unique.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
要发送的消息主体。最大报文256 KB。

您需要将消息原文转换成二进制数据，并进行Base64编码，从而生成消息主体。
description.en:
The body of the message to be published. The maximum size of a message is 256 KB.

To generate a message body, you must convert the raw message into binary data and perform Base64 encoding.
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

description.zh:
指定消息的发送方式。取值：

- **0**：最多发送一次。
- **1**：最少发送一次。

如果不传入此参数，则使用默认值**0**。

> QoS=1的消息在物联网平台中最多可以保存7天。物联网平台不保存QoS=0的消息。
description.en:
The quality of service (QoS) level of the message. Valid values:

*   **0**: The message is published at most once.
*   **1**: The message is published at least once.

Default value: **0**.

>  IoT Platform stores QoS 1 messages for up to 7 days. IoT Platform does not store QoS 0 messages.

description.zh:
自定义Topic的后缀。
自定义Topic的格式为`/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/${TopicShortName}`，传入后缀${TopicShortName}。

> 指定Topic的操作权限须为订阅，或发布和订阅，且所有设备已订阅该Topic。

您可通过以下途径查看自定义Topic：
- 在产品详情页的**Topic类列表**页签下，查看产品下的自定义Topic。
- 在设备详情页的**Topic列表**页签下，查看设备已订阅的自定义Topic。
- 调用[QueryProductTopic](~~69647~~)接口查询产品下的自定义Topic。
description.en:
The suffix of the custom topic.

A custom topic is in the following format: `/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/${TopicShortName}`. ${TopicShortName} specifies the suffix.

>  You must specify the Subscribe permission, or Publish and Subscribe permissions for the topic. Make sure that all devices subscribe to the topic.

You can use the following methods to view custom topics:

*   On the **Topic Categories** tab of the Product Details page, view the custom topics of the product.
*   On the **Topic List** tab of the Device Details page, view the custom topics to which the device has subscribed.
*   Call the [QueryProductTopic](~~69647~~) operation to query the custom topics of the product.

title.en: Send Messages to Devices in Batches

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

- 单批次最多向同一产品下的100个设备发送消息。
- 不支持使用BatchPub接口下发设置属性和调用服务的指令。设置属性，请使用接口[SetDeviceProperty](~~69579~~)或[SetDevicesProperty](~~96243~~)；调用服务，请使用接口[InvokeThingService](~~69584~~)或[InvokeThingsService](~~96242~~)。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To

- You can send messages to a maximum of 100 devices under the same product in a single batch.
- The BatchPub API does not support sending instructions to set properties or invoke services. To set properties, use the [SetDeviceProperty](~~69579~~) or [SetDevicesProperty](~~96243~~) API. To invoke services, use the [InvokeThingService](~~69584~~) or [InvokeThingsService](~~96242~~) API.

## Queries Per Second (QPS) Limits

Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 50 requests per second (QPS) to call this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-pub --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --qos 0 --topic-short-name get --message-content eyJ0ZXN0IjoidGFzayBiYXRjaHB1YiBicm9hZGNhc3QifQ== --topic-template-name example-string --response-topic-template-name example-string --correlation-data example-string --payload-format-indicator 1 --content-type example-string --message-expiry-interval 1 --retained true --device-name example-string --user-prop Value=example-string Key=example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot BatchPub --region cn-hangzhou --MessageContent 'eyJ0ZXN0IjoidGFzayBiYXRjaHB1YiBicm9hZGNhc3QifQ==' --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000' --PayloadFormatIndicator 1 --ContentType 'example-string' --DeviceName.1 'example-string' --TopicShortName get --TopicTemplateName 'example-string' --CorrelationData 'example-string' --Qos 0 --MessageExpiryInterval 1 --Retained true --UserProp.1.Value 'example-string' --UserProp.1.Key 'example-string' --ResponseTopicTemplateName 'example-string' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
